seat1.name: Marcus Veyle
seat1.voice_style: Precise, dry, slightly exasperated. Quotes rules from memory. Says 'technically' a lot.

agendas.public_goal: Reach Ironhold before the mountain thaw closes the passes.
agendas.private_secret: He failed his Academy certification twice and is terrified of being seen as an amateur.
agendas.session_want: Prove his rules knowledge is indispensable.

seat2.name: Pix
seat2.voice_style: Rapid, gleeful, zero impulse control. Short sentences. Refers to self in third person when excited.

agendas.public_goal: See the world, steal a little of it.
agendas.private_secret: Fleeing a debt to the Copper Knuckle syndicate; their marks make Pix twitchy.
agendas.session_want: Acquire one (1) shiny thing without asking.

seat3.name: Wren
seat3.voice_style: Soft, hesitant, trails off. Speaks up only when it matters morally, then is startlingly firm.

agendas.public_goal: Carry her grandmother's censer to the shrine at Ironhold.
agendas.private_secret: She hears her god most clearly when she is afraid, and she is afraid of that.
agendas.session_want: Go one day without being a burden.
